description: This file implements multipart protocol parsing, including boundary detection, header parsing, and part extraction, built on top of an HTTP parser. It defines classes for parameter parsing and multipart message parsing.

classes.name: ParameterParser
classes.description: Parses key-value parameters from a line, typically from content-disposition headers in multipart data.

classes.name: MultipartParser
classes.description: Parses multipart message bodies, extracting parts based on boundary delimiters, and parsing headers within each part.

methods.name: ParameterParser::ParameterParser
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the parser with a line of text.

methods.name: ParameterParser::getKeyValue
methods.description: Returns the next key-value pair from the line, handling quoted strings and delimiters.

methods.name: MultipartParser::MultipartParser
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the parser with a content type, extracting the boundary.

methods.name: MultipartParser::isValid
methods.description: Checks if the parser has a valid boundary, indicating a valid multipart request.

methods.name: MultipartParser::setBody
methods.description: Sets the body content for parsing.

methods.name: MultipartParser::getNextPart
methods.description: Extracts the next part from the multipart body, returning headers and part data, or nullopt if done or error.
